recipes.name: Vibrant Roasted Beetroot Hummus
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C)*.
Cut the beets into ½ inch (1 cm) slices and transfer to the baking tray. Roast for 40 to 45 minutes, or until cooked through. Set aside to cool.
Add all the ingredients to a food processor and blend until smooth. Taste test and adjust the lemon, tahini, oil, and salt to your liking.

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
